references.text: The Lord looked with favor on Abel's offering, indicating divine acceptance of the sacrifice, just as fire from the Lord showed acceptance in Leviticus 9:24
A flaming fire passed between the pieces of Abram's sacrifice, showing God's presence through fire at covenant making
Moses met God at the burning bush and hid his face, just as the people fell on their faces in awe before the Lord's glory
The Lord came down on Mount Sinai in fire, demonstrating God's manifestation through fire
The Lord's glory was like a consuming fire on top of the mountain, visible to the Israelites
Fire went out from the Lord's presence and consumed Nadab and Abihu, showing that the same divine fire that accepted the sacrifice also judged unauthorized approach
Fire went out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering incense, demonstrating God's judgment through fire
The Lord your God is a consuming fire, describing God's nature manifested in the fire of His presence
Fire rose from the rock and consumed Gideon's sacrifice, confirming the Lord's messenger and God's acceptance
The angel of the Lord ascended in the flame from the altar as Manoah offered his sacrifice, and he and his wife fell on their faces
The Lord's fire fell down and consumed the burnt offering on Mount Carmel, and the people fell on their faces and cried out that the Lord is God
Fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering at the dedication of Solomon's temple, and the people bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped
An invitation to bow down and cast themselves before the Lord, reflecting the people's response in awe
Isaiah's vision of the Lord's glory in the temple, where the seraphim cried out about God's holiness, paralleling the people's reverence
Our God is a consuming fire, repeating the theme of God's holy presence manifested as fire
